authority: Latest user: Stop pausing. Use Luna and Claude Haiku implementation/review. Fix blockers and keep going. Parent treats this as authorization for supported bounded preparation and execution; child design-only scope restricts child actions, not existing user authority.

budget_basis.note: Estimates are planning bounds, not runtime guarantees. Keep hard deadline; no cap relaxation.

source_policy: New isolated prospective adapter from audited r3; no historical validators/configs/metadata edits. All failed and diagnostic checkpoints remain ineligible.
normal_checkpoint_contract: New schema only. Save exact model/Adam/RNG, actual counters, current/next episode seed indices, run_seed, abandoned episodes and registration hashes at complete update boundaries. Do not flip old diagnostic eligibility. Training continuation is provisional until exact parent terminal acceptance; stage progression is a separate v3 survival predicate. Any future resume requires separately frozen/validated registration, cumulative consumed wall anchor and exact lineage; no resume implementation required in first campaign.
campaign_success: Completed registered80 updates, finite valid metrics, full final evaluation, raw0 exits, resource/deadline/postflight/ownership checks. A below3060 competence score is reported separately from normal completion; no automatic D3 or B/E opening.
actual_failure: Retain partial artifacts; failure/cancel/timeout/incomplete/interrupted checkpoints cannot parent future training. No unchanged broken rerun.
telemetry: Add authoritative phase_update to completed/reset episode records. Preserve direct critic pre/post measurements, death counts and Q1/Q4/mean.
parent_adjustments_to_luna_plan: Reject request for another user go: latest user explicitly authorized continuation, child design does not revoke it.
Increase48 to80updates to advance measured learning, with conservative measured budget.
Use narrow new prospective adapter rather than large old-runner migration.
Separate normal iteration completion from competence advancement without changing any historical verdict or eligibility.

input_drift.reason: Parent updated live project report with independently audited completed results while design read it. No immutable source/run input drift.
